Use case

Missed-Call Text-Back

THE PAIN

Missed calls are silent revenue leaks — the caller rarely tries twice.

THE MECHANIC

Within seconds of a missed call, HazirMinds texts the caller: acknowledges the miss, opens a two-way conversation, and rescues the booking.

THE OUTCOME

A meaningful share of missed calls convert into booked jobs instead of lost opportunities.
